# Modules baked into the signed standalone GRUB core image (consumed by
# grub-mkstandalone --modules, see tools/xtask/src/grub.rs). This list IS the
# verified-boot base's attack surface: every module here is code inside the
# signed EFI binary, so it stays minimal and every entry must be load-bearing
# for grub.cfg. Non-obvious entries, and why they are needed:
#
#   part_gpt      read the GPT partition table (the disk is GPT)
#   fat           read the FAT filesystems on ESP/STATE/slot partitions
#   normal        GRUB's normal mode; runs the embedded grub.cfg
#   multiboot2    the multiboot2/module2 loader seL4's x86 boot path requires
#   mmap          the `cutmem` that keeps the boot module out of low memory,
#                 without which seL4 loads the userland image over its own
#                 kernel; see the reservation in grub.cfg
#   test          the `[ ... ]` conditionals in grub.cfg's slot logic
#   echo          the `LFW-BOOT slot=… state=…` records the A/B test asserts on
#   halt          halt on the no-bootable-slot recovery path
#   loadenv       load_env/save_env for the grubenv boot-selection state
#   pgp           enforce detached-signature verification on loaded files
#   gcry_rsa      RSA verification backend for pgp
#   gcry_sha256   SHA-256 digest backend for pgp
part_gpt
fat
normal
multiboot2
mmap
test
echo
halt
loadenv
pgp
gcry_rsa
gcry_sha256
